home.pyramidsHeroPhrase: Created by us. Only at OSIRIS.
home.pyramidsHeroDescription: PYRAMIDS is a fragrance we created ourselves. It is not a copy of a well-known perfume or another version of someone else’s scent. We composed it especially for OSIRIS: juicy strawberry and green apple in the opening, raspberry at the heart, then patchouli, oakmoss, sandalwood and tonka beans in the base. You will not find this fragrance anywhere else — it is our own composition.
home.pyramidsHeroClosing: If you want to smell like no one else, begin with PYRAMIDS.
home.pyramidsFeatureCopy: Juicy strawberry, green apple and raspberry settle into a warm trail of patchouli, oakmoss, sandalwood and tonka beans. An independent composition with the character of OSIRIS.
home.pyramidsNotes: Pink strawberry · Green apple · Raspberry · Patchouli · Oakmoss · Sandalwood · Tonka beans
home.featuredFragrancesSubtitle: Begin with our original PYRAMIDS and discover the rest of the collection.
home.brandHeroTitle: OSIRIS — a world of fragrance without limits
home.brandHeroHighlight: Arabic. International. Egyptian. And our own original creations.
home.brandHeroBody1: At OSIRIS, we bring together different fragrance directions in one collection: rich Arabic perfumes, recognizable international compositions, Egyptian-inspired scents, and original fragrances created by us.
home.brandHeroBody2: We want everyone to find a scent that feels personal — bold and oriental, fresh and light, sweet, woody, or truly distinctive. And some creations, such as PYRAMIDS, can only be found at OSIRIS.
home.brandHeroClosing: OSIRIS — choose a fragrance they will remember.
